summary: Co-authoring a 2025 report with Van Hollen that called Israel's Gaza actions "ethnic cleansing" and the United States "complicit," Merkley has taken sustained action against Israeli military operations. He spoke on the Senate floor in support of blocking offensive weapons sales to the Netanyahu government and on starvation in Gaza, diverging from Wyden on arms-sales votes. Vote for Peace rates him an Ally in the general election.
